create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to set SLURM parameters like memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition
create_scheduler_config: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure the scheduler mode, distributed init method, and number of nodes
review_jobconfig_post_init: review the JobConfig __post_init__ method that auto-generates Metadata with log, checkpoint, and results directory paths
create_scheduler_type_enum: create a SchedulerType StrEnum with LOCAL and SLURM values for selecting the job scheduler backend
